rows.label: Pass rate over expected

rows.label: Neutral pace
rows.def: Average seconds between back-to-back snaps on the same drive, counted only while the game is neutral: win probability between 20% and 80%, with more than two minutes left in the half. Gaps over 60 seconds (timeouts, reviews, quarter breaks) are dropped. Lower is faster.

rows.label: Early-down pass rate
rows.def: Pass share on every 1st- and 2nd-down snap, whatever the score - not only neutral situations. Same pass definition as the pass rate, so sacks and scrambles count as passes.

rows.label: No-huddle rate
rows.def: Share of offensive snaps the play-by-play marks as no-huddle, over the same snaps as the pass rate.

rows.label: Play-action rate
rows.def: Share of dropbacks that FTN charting marks as play-action. The denominator is dropbacks, not pass attempts, so sacks and scrambles are in it.

rows.label: Pre-snap motion
rows.sub: before or at the snap, FTN charting
rows.def: Share of FTN-charted snaps with motion before or at the snap, as FTN defines it. That includes a player who motions and resets before the ball is snapped, not only one still moving when it is.

rows.label: Shotgun rate
rows.def: Share of offensive snaps the play-by-play logs as shotgun, over the same snaps as the pass rate. Pistol is not tracked separately: a pistol snap counts only if the play-by-play logs it as shotgun.

rows.label: Red-zone pass rate
rows.def: Pass share on snaps at the opponent's 20-yard line or closer. Sacks and scrambles count as passes; kneels, spikes, two-point tries and snaps wiped out by penalty are removed. It counts plays, not trips, so a few long red-zone drives can move it a lot early in a season.

rows.label: 4th-down go rate
rows.def: Share of 4th-and-2-or-less snaps in opponent territory (midfield included) where the offense ran a play instead of punting or attempting a field goal. Snaps wiped out by penalty are removed. Shown as - until a team has had three such snaps.

shifts.heading: The offense sped up.

shifts.heading: More under center.

shifts.heading: More play-action.

rows.label: Pass rate (all downs)
rows.def: Share of offensive snaps that were dropbacks. Sacks and QB scrambles count as passes, since both began as pass plays. Kneels, spikes, two-point tries and snaps wiped out by penalty are removed. Regular season only, as is every row here.

rows.label: Pass rate over expected
rows.def: The average of nflverse's pass-over-expected value across the same snaps as the pass rate: whether each snap was a pass, minus the chance an average team passes in that down, distance, field position, score and time remaining. Positive means this staff passes more than the situation predicts.

rows.label: Neutral pace
rows.def: Average seconds between back-to-back snaps on the same drive, counted only while the game is neutral: win probability between 20% and 80%, with more than two minutes left in the half. Gaps over 60 seconds (timeouts, reviews, quarter breaks) are dropped. Lower is faster.

rows.label: Early-down pass rate
rows.def: Pass share on every 1st- and 2nd-down snap, whatever the score - not only neutral situations. Same pass definition as the pass rate, so sacks and scrambles count as passes.

rows.label: No-huddle rate
rows.def: Share of offensive snaps the play-by-play marks as no-huddle, over the same snaps as the pass rate.

rows.label: Play-action rate
rows.def: Share of dropbacks that FTN charting marks as play-action. The denominator is dropbacks, not pass attempts, so sacks and scrambles are in it.

rows.label: Pre-snap motion
rows.sub: before or at the snap, FTN charting
rows.def: Share of FTN-charted snaps with motion before or at the snap, as FTN defines it. That includes a player who motions and resets before the ball is snapped, not only one still moving when it is.

rows.label: Shotgun rate
rows.def: Share of offensive snaps the play-by-play logs as shotgun, over the same snaps as the pass rate. Pistol is not tracked separately: a pistol snap counts only if the play-by-play logs it as shotgun.

rows.label: Red-zone pass rate
rows.def: Pass share on snaps at the opponent's 20-yard line or closer. Sacks and scrambles count as passes; kneels, spikes, two-point tries and snaps wiped out by penalty are removed. It counts plays, not trips, so a few long red-zone drives can move it a lot early in a season.

rows.label: 4th-down go rate
rows.def: Share of 4th-and-2-or-less snaps in opponent territory (midfield included) where the offense ran a play instead of punting or attempting a field goal. Snaps wiped out by penalty are removed. Shown as - until a team has had three such snaps.

ten.bottomLine: The fantasy bottom line: Brian Daboll is new to the Titans call sheet in 2026, so 2025 tendencies describe a different coach's offense.
